name: Dissolution

targets.description: a creature or nonmagical object you touch

summary: Melee spell attack: 1d8 Force, and the target's AC is 1 lower against the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn.
text: You touch a creature or nonmagical object and break its substance down into its most fundamental components. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit the target takes 1d8 Force damage, and its AC is reduced by 1 against the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn. Cantrip Upgrade: the damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
